products.name: Butter Chicken
products.shortDescription: Chargrilled chicken thigh in a silky tomato and butter sauce.
products.description: Our signature. Chicken thigh is marinated overnight in yoghurt and spices, chargrilled, then folded through a slow-reduced tomato makhani finished with butter, cream and dried fenugreek leaf. Rich, rounded and gently spiced.
products.ingredients: Chicken thigh (38%), tomato, onion, **cream (milk)**, **butter (milk)**, **yoghurt (milk)**, ginger, garlic, rapeseed oil, ground spices, dried fenugreek leaf, sugar, salt.
products.storage: Keep refrigerated at 5°C or below and eat by the use-by date on the pack. Once opened, consume within 24 hours. Suitable for home freezing: freeze on the day of delivery and use within one month. Defrost fully in the fridge before reheating.
preparation: Microwave (800W): pierce the film, heat for 3 minutes, stir, then heat for a further 1–2 minutes.
Hob: empty into a saucepan and warm over a medium heat for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Check the food is piping hot throughout before serving. Do not reheat more than once.
